# Requests and APIs

Follow a request through the framework, expose whitelisted methods, use and customize the REST API, and connect AI clients over MCP.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Request Lifecycle](request-lifecycle.md) | Follow one HTTP request through frappe.app.application, from site resolution, session and auth to dispatch, commit, response, cleanup and errors. |
| [Whitelisted Methods](whitelisted-methods.md) | Expose Python functions over HTTP with @frappe.whitelist, validate arguments with type annotations, restrict access by role, rate limit, and override methods of other apps. |
| [REST API](rest-api.md) | Read and change documents and call whitelisted methods over HTTP with /api/v1 (resource, method) and /api/v2 (document, doctype, method), including list parameters, bulk operations, responses and errors. |
| [API Internals](api-internals.md) | How Frappe routes an /api request to a function, checks whitelist, guest and HTTP method rules, binds arguments, and turns frappe.response into JSON, files, redirects and errors. |
| [Customizing APIs](customizing-apis.md) | Every way an app can add or change API behavior in Frappe, from whitelisted methods and overrides to doc_events, permission hooks, request hooks, auth hooks, CORS, response formats, versioning and tests. |
| [MCP and API Discovery](mcp-and-discovery.md) | Connect AI agents to a site through the built-in MCP endpoint at /api/v2/mcp, and describe whitelisted methods with the /api/v2/discovery endpoints. |
